headline: Renting a room in Beja is increasingly expensive: prices soar 12% in a year and reach 301 euros per month - Rádio Pax 2026
summary: Rents for a simple room in Beja have risen 12% in one year, the largest increase reported. The average price reached 301 euros per month.
why: Rising rents reflect housing cost pressure, which affects consumer spending, wage demands and residential real estate values.
